name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Override version (e.g. v2.28.0). Leave empty to auto-bump.'
        required: false
        type: string
      bump:
        description: 'patch / minor / major — used when version is empty (default: minor)'
        required: false
        default: 'minor'
        type: choice
        options:
          - patch
          - minor
          - major

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version: '1.19'

    - name: Run tests
      run: go test ./...

    - name: Determine version
      id: determine_version
      run: |
        if [[ "${{ github.event.inputs.version }}" != "" ]]; then
          echo "VERSION=${{ github.event.inputs.version }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        else
          LATEST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
          BUMP_TYPE="${{ github.event.inputs.bump }}"
          VERSION=$(./scripts/version.sh "$LATEST_TAG" "$BUMP_TYPE")
          echo "VERSION=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        fi

    - name: Install git-cliff
      uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
      with:
        tool: git-cliff
        version: 2.12.0

    - name: Generate CHANGELOG
      run: git-cliff --config .cliff.toml --tag ${{ env.VERSION }} > CHANGELOG.md

    - name: Commit CHANGELOG and create tag
      run: |
        git add CHANGELOG.md
        git commit -m "chore: update CHANGELOG for version ${{ env.VERSION }}"
        git tag ${{ env.VERSION }}
        git push origin HEAD ${env.VERSION}

    - name: Run Goreleaser
      uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v6
      with:
        version: ${{ env.VERSION }}
        args: --rm-dist
        install-only: true
      env:
        GORELEASER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GORELEASER_TOKEN }}

    - name: Build and release
      uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v6
      with:
        version: ${{ env.VERSION }}
        args: --rm-dist
      env:
        GORELEASER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GORELEASER_TOKEN }}
